# T-5: Diagnose schema overrides

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Expose missing schema support for docs.text when resolved provider/profile settings omit jsonSchemaFlag or jsonSchemaMode.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Diagnostic output identifies commandId docs.text and missing jsonSchemaFlag/jsonSchemaMode.
- User-provided provider/profile values are not overwritten.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer a testable warning or error path tied to docs.text schema use. Avoid logging secrets or full prompts.

## Test Strategy
Unit test a local override profile without schema fields and assert the diagnostic content.
